resources.string: Enter your zip code so the guide can show your local channels. Your zip stays on this device. There is no account.

Android will ask for your approximate location. The app reads the last location your phone already knows, uses it once to suggest a zip code, and does not store or send it anywhere. You can always type your zip instead.

Your phone doesn\'t have a recent location. Please type your zip code.
Location permission was not granted. No problem: type your zip code instead.
These are the nearest markets to your zip. The nearest isn\'t always the one your stations broadcast from, so choose the one that matches your local news.
That zip isn\'t in the built-in table. Show all markets to pick yours.
This just labels your guide. The guide lists your market\'s local channels and cannot know which channels your plan includes, so use Edit number on a channel to match your lineup.

Notifications are off, so reminders can\'t alert you. Turn them on in system settings.

Alerts shortly before a show you chose starts.
The guide is downloaded at most once a day to be kind to the free data source. Refreshing sooner just re-checks what is saved.
This replaces your Home setup. If you pick a different market, your channel numbers, categories, favorites and reminders for the old market are removed. Nothing changes if you cancel.
This clears the channel numbers and categories you set. Favorites are kept.
Remind me before a show starts
Must start with https://. Changing it downloads the guide again from the new address.
Listings: EPGTalk. Zip positions: US Census data.
On first launch, enter your zip (or let the app suggest one), pick your local market, and say how you watch TV. The guide downloads and opens. You can redo setup any time in Settings.

Channels run down the left, time runs across. Swipe sideways for later shows or use Earlier, Now and Later. The gold line is the current time. The guide ends where the listings end, about three days out. Tap a show for details. A channel with nothing scheduled says "No listings".

Tap a channel to change its number, give it a category, or mark it a favorite. If you give a channel a number another channel already uses, the other one shows "?" until you give it a number. Channels with "?" sort last. Categories you create appear as filters above the guide. Reset in Settings clears numbers and categories but keeps favorites.
Favorite a channel from its menu, or a single show from its details. Use the Favorites filter to see just your favorite channels, in number order.
Search finds channels by name or number, and programs by title or description, listed in channel-number order.

Open an upcoming show and tap Remind me. The first time, Android asks to allow notifications; without it reminders can\'t alert you. Manage or cancel reminders in Settings. Reminders survive restarts and are dropped if the show disappears from the guide. They can arrive a minute or two off, because Android groups background alarms to save battery.
The guide is saved on your phone and works without a connection. It refreshes in the background about once a day. If a refresh fails, you keep the saved guide, your numbers, favorites and reminders.

No account, no ads, no tracking. Your zip, choices, favorites and reminders are stored only on this device. Location is optional: if you allow it, the app reads your phone\'s last known approximate location once to suggest a zip, and does not keep or send it. The only network request the app makes is downloading the public guide file.

Listings come from EPGTalk\'s free public TV guide (epgtalk.com), used with the maintainer\'s approval. Zip code positions are derived from US Census Bureau data (via the open-source US-Zip-Codes-JSON list, MIT license). The market list follows EPGTalk\'s US Local coverage.

This is a guide, not a player: it doesn\'t play TV or video. Listings are per local market, not per provider, so your provider may not carry every channel shown and its numbers may differ; edit numbers to match. Zip codes are matched to the nearest market, which can differ from your actual broadcast area; pick another in Change location if needed. Listings can contain errors and are only as good as the source.
